5. Identification of city and regional marketing milieu – inner and outer settings of cities and regions, information and analyses. (dotace 1/2)
6. Searching for positioning of cities and regions in competitive milieu - positioning, segmentation and target groups. (dotace 1/2)

7. Application of marketing mix – urban and regional product, quality of urban and regional product, prices, distribution and material settings, communication mix, human resources, processes and partnership. (dotace 1/2)
8. Media, cities and regions – influence of national media, urban and regional images. (dotace 2/4)
9. Methods and techniques of territorial marketing - methods, techniques, models and practice of territorial marketing (dotace 1/2)
10. Implementation or city and regional marketing – strategic development of cities and regions and the role of territorial marketing, towards the complex territorial marketing. (dotace 1/2)

cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: The main objective of the course lies in familiarisation of students with the role and importance of regional and city marketing for territorial development. We will analyse the reasons of the introduction as well as spreading of this dynamic discipline. Attention will be devoted to elements and processes belonging to regional and urban marketing. Apart from theoretical aspects and continuities of territorial marketing, its practical application is not neglected as it becomes an inseparable part of territorial managements.

cs.label: [section] Požadavky na ukončení:
cs.content: Credit is awarded on the basis of the completion of seminar work. Each seminar work is evaluated between 0 and 30 points. This seminar work will be presented. Each presentation is assessed in the range of 0-15 points. To obtain the credit, total amount of points from the seminar work and presentation should reach at least 23. Maximum number of points related to the credit is 45. Exam can be accomplished just after the credit is awarded. Written exam is evaluated and students can get from 0 to 55 points. Final evaluation is awarded on the basis of the sum of the points from credit and exam. The degrees are as follows: A 90-100 points B 80-89 points C 70-79 points D 60-69 points E 50-59 points F less than 50 points
